items.label: la nuque
items.scene: A girl with her hair up touches the little NOOK ("NEWK") at the NAPE of her neck, where a cold raindrop from the skylight just landed.

items.label: la canne
items.scene: A grandpa taps a tin CAN ("KAHN") off the runner with his walking CANE.

items.label: la cheville
items.scene: A toy CHEVY ("shuh-VEE") car has rolled into a girl's foot, and she sits on the bench rubbing her ANKLE.

items.label: la tempe
items.scene: A boy who bumped his head holds an ice pack to his TEMPLE, little stars still circling from the THUMP ("TAHNP").

items.label: la coiffure
items.scene: A lady's towering HAIRSTYLE is so grand that a QUAIL ("kwah") nests in it with A FEW ("FEWR") tiny eggs.

items.label: la sonnette
items.scene: A poet in a velvet beret reads a SONNET ("soh-NEHT") aloud while pressing the brass DOORBELL by the workshop door.

items.label: l'os
items.scene: An OSTRICH ("OS-trich") strides along the landing carrying a huge white BONE in its beak.

items.label: le nerf
items.scene: A mouse with NERVES ("NEHR") of steel walks a tightrope stretched NEAR the ceiling, balancing a pencil.

items.label: le coiffeur
items.scene: A duck HAIRDRESSER QUACKS ("kwah") happily as she snips a poodle's FUR ("FUHR") into neat pompoms.

items.label: le foulard
items.scene: A jester, a merry FOOL ("foo"), ties a silk HEADSCARF under his chin while a LARK ("LAHR") hops on his shoulder.
